notes: This benchmark tests 3D black-box ReLU hyperplane stitching across deterministic randomized teachers with repeated noisy and quantized oracle calls only.
It reduces fixed-teacher risk for noisy 3D recovery but still does not prove arbitrary ND, deep, adversarial near-collision, or production API decompilation.
